content: Attachments are part of the standard AG-UI InputContent schema (content parts: text/image/audio/video/file with source+metadata). CopilotChat attachments prop: {enabled, accept, maxSize(20MB), onUpload, onUploadFailed}. Default onUpload reads files as base64 inline (type:'data'); can return {type:'url',value,mimeType} for hosted uploads. No server-side file storage needed in base64 mode — good fit for local-first. Known bug: Vue attachments fail with structuredClone error (#6104) — attachments on @copilotkit/vue are rough; defer or test carefully.
